patterns.note: Extensive use of full-bleed, high-resolution photography as primary visual elements, often serving as section backgrounds or dominant content blocks.
Consistent application of a clean, modern sans-serif typeface, with headings often in uppercase and body text in a lighter weight for an elegant feel.
A predominantly monochromatic color scheme (black, white, and grayscale photography) creating a sophisticated and minimalist aesthetic.
No scroll-triggered motion observed in the provided sequence; the design relies on static, impactful imagery and generous whitespace for visual hierarchy.
Large, distinct content sections are separated by significant vertical whitespace, often featuring a single dominant image or a curated grid of related visuals.

technique_notes: To achieve the full-bleed imagery, use large image elements or background images set to cover the full width of the viewport, often with a high aspect ratio to fill vertical space.

The minimalist typography can be recreated by selecting a single versatile sans-serif font family and applying variations in weight and size for clear hierarchy, with headings often transformed to uppercase.
The monochromatic palette is established by using pure white for backgrounds, deep black for primary text, and allowing the high-contrast black and white photography to define the visual texture.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant and balanced, with prominent, often uppercase sans-serif headings (~2-3x body text) and clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, characterized by generous vertical and horizontal whitespace, particularly around large images and text blocks, conveying a sense of luxury and focus.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large-scale, high-contrast black and white photography, often full-bleed, creates an editorial and art-gallery-like experience. This emphasis on impactful, artistic imagery over complex layouts or animations makes the product feel like a curated art piece.
